how_to_apply: Visit the official NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in
Note the applicable Advertisement Number: For Graduates: AATN260810820114841 For Diploma holders: AATN260810848114847
Click on "Student Register" and complete the application form.
A unique Enrolment Number will be generated for each student.
After enrolment, log in using your email ID and password.
Search for "National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli."
Click "Apply." You can check your application status after applying.
Applicants are responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents, and photographs submitted with their application.

content_sections.heading: NIT Trichy Apprentice Trainee Important Dates
content_sections.text: The official notification specifies only the notification date and the closing date for applications. No separate application start date is mentioned in the notification. Note: A specific application start date is not mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: NIT Trichy Apprentice Trainee Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NIT Trichy has announced a total of 24 apprentice vacancies for the 2026-2027 engagement cycle, covering Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Trainees across various disciplines. Note: A discipline-wise or post-wise breakup of the 24 vacancies is not specified in the notification provided.

rows.category: Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Trainees (all disciplines)

content_sections.heading: NIT Trichy Apprentice Trainee Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The notification is open to Graduate, Diploma, and Vocational Certificate holders across various disciplines. Specific degree/branch-wise qualification requirements are not detailed in the notification. Candidates must have their apprenticeship forms registered with BOAT/BOPT within 3 years from the date of passing their final examination (as per F.No. 13-7/2017-TS.VII dated 17.12.2021). The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience requirements for candidates with exceptional credentials. Reservation will be followed as per Government of India norms. Candidates already employed (Government or any other organization) must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of the interview.

content_sections.heading: NIT Trichy Apprentice Trainee Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend during the one-year training period, as detailed below.

content_sections.heading: NIT Trichy Apprentice Trainee Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification indicates that shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, since already-employed applicants are asked to submit an NOC "at the time of interview" and no TA/DA is payable "for attending the interview." Beyond this, the exact stages of the selection process (such as any written test or document verification) are not detailed in the notification. The decision of the selection committee is final, and canvassing in any form will lead to rejection of the candidature.

faq.question: Q1. What is NIT Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the official engagement of Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Trainees at NIT Tiruchirappalli for the year 2026-2027 under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), as per notification F.No. NITT/R/RC/Apprentice/2026/2 dated 19.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NIT Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 24 vacancies are available for Graduate and Diploma Apprentice Trainees across various disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NIT Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 02.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NIT Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants should be Graduate, Diploma, or Vocational Certificate holders. Discipline-specific qualification details are not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply online for NIT Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must register on the NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in), complete their enrolment, and then apply against the advertised vacancy by searching for "National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli" under "Apply against advertised vacancies."

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NIT Trichy Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification indicates candidates will be called for an interview. Other selection stages are not specified in the notification.
